endpoints.description: Create a relationship between two elements with its ends set: source/target for directed kinds (Generalization, Dependency, Realization, InterfaceRealization, Include, Extend, Transition, ControlFlow, ObjectFlow, Message, flows of the other diagram families), end1/end2 for undirected ones (Association with end name, navigability, aggregation, multiplicity; Link; ERD relationship; connectors). With diagramId the edge view is created too, through StarUML's own factory and its connection rules; tail/head may then be view ids or ids of models shown on that diagram.

type.description: With diagramId: a model-and-view id (see /introspect factory.modelAndView) or a toolbox item id that presets one, e.g. 'UMLComposition', 'UMLReplyMessage', 'ERDRelationshipOneToMany'. Without: a metamodel class whose relationship kind is directed or undirected.

tailId.description: Source end: a model, or a view on the diagram.

headId.description: Target end: a model, or a view on the diagram.

diagramId.description: Diagram to draw the relationship on.

parentId.description: Owner of the relationship. With a diagram it is passed to the factory as the diagram editor does (default the diagram's owner); most relationship factories file the relationship under the tail model regardless. Without a diagram the default is the tail's owner when that has a list for this type (messages, edges, transitions), else the tail model.

field.description: Without a diagram: owner list to add to; default the list typed for the relationship, e.g. 'messages' of a UMLInteraction.

properties.description: Initial attribute values by name, as /introspect lists them: plain values for prim/enum attributes, an id or {$ref: id} for references, arrays of those for reference lists. E.g. {messageSort: "asynchCall"} for a UMLMessage, {guard: "x > 0"} for a UMLControlFlow.

tailEnd.description: Undirected relationships only: attributes of end1, e.g. {name, navigable, aggregation, multiplicity} for a UMLAssociation.

headEnd.description: Undirected relationships only: attributes of end2.

x1.description: Edge start in diagram coordinates; default the tail view's centre. For a sequence message, y1/y2 place it on the lifelines.

x2.description: Edge end; default the head view's centre.

endpoints.description: The diagram editor's state: current and open diagrams, zoom, scroll position, grid.

currentDiagram.description: Id of the diagram shown in the editor.

workingDiagrams.description: Ids of the diagrams open as editor tabs, in tab order.

topLeft.description: Diagram coordinates shown at the viewport's top-left corner; null without a current diagram.

endpoints.description: Change the diagram editor's view: show a diagram, zoom, scroll, grid. Nothing here changes the model or the undo history; gridVisible and snapToGrid are stored as StarUML preferences, as the View menu does.

diagramId.description: Diagram to open and show first.

center.description: Diagram point to centre the viewport on, in diagram units.

currentDiagram.description: Id of the diagram shown in the editor.

workingDiagrams.description: Ids of the diagrams open as editor tabs, in tab order.

topLeft.description: Diagram coordinates shown at the viewport's top-left corner; null without a current diagram.

endpoints.description: Render a diagram as PNG, JPEG or SVG, as File > Export Diagram As does, and return it base64-encoded or write it to a file.

id.description: Diagram id; default the current diagram.

scale.description: Pixels per diagram unit for PNG and JPEG, up to 4; default 1. File > Export uses the display's pixel ratio. SVG is unscaled.

background.description: CSS colour behind the diagram, e.g. '#ffffff'. Default transparent, white for JPEG.

path.description: Absolute file to write; overwritten, parent directories created. Omit to receive the image in the response.

width.description: Pixels; SVG user units for svg.

path.description: The file written, when 'path' was given.

base64.description: The image, when 'path' was not given.

endpoints.description: Write diagrams as image files into a directory, one per diagram named after it, as File > Export Diagrams does; /export_diagram renders one.

path.description: Absolute directory to write into; created if missing. Files of the same name are overwritten.

ids.description: Diagram ids; default every diagram in the project.

endpoints.description: Write diagrams to a PDF file, one page each, as File > Print to PDF and the CLI's pdf command do.

ids.description: Diagram ids in page order; default every diagram in the project.

showName.description: Print each diagram's path name; default true.

endpoints.description: Write HTML documentation of the whole project, with diagram images, into a directory (File > Export > HTML Docs).

path.description: Absolute directory to write into; created if missing. index.html is its entry page.

endpoints.description: Which code generator extensions are installed, for /generate_code and /reverse_code, with the options each takes from its preferences.
Generate source code from a model element with an installed generator extension (Tools > <Language> > Generate Code) into a directory, and list the files written.

language.description: Generator language: java, cpp, csharp or python.

baseId.description: Element to generate from: a package or model generates its whole tree, a class or interface one file.

path.description: Absolute output directory; created if missing. A package becomes a subdirectory named after it, and the Java generator fails if that already exists.

options.description: Generator options by name, e.g. {indentSpaces: 2, javaDoc: false} for Java; the rest come from the generator's preferences (see /list_code_generators).

files.description: Files created or rewritten, relative to path, sorted.

endpoints.description: Reverse-engineer a source directory into the open project with an installed generator extension (Tools > <Language> > Reverse Code), and summarize the elements it added.

language.description: Generator language: java, cpp, csharp or python.

path.description: Absolute directory whose source files are read, recursively.

options.description: Analyzer options by name, e.g. {association: false, publicOnly: true} for Java; the rest come from its preferences.

created.description: Elements added, views and diagrams included.

roots.description: The added elements whose owner existed before, e.g. the top-level packages.

modified.description: Whether the project has changes not yet saved to its file.

endpoints.description: Run several endpoint calls in one request. Later ops refer to earlier results as '$name' (the result's id), '$name.view' or '$name.model'. atomic (default true) makes the whole batch one undo step and undoes it all when an op fails; atomic false runs every op and reports each.

body.description: The endpoint's request body. Strings '$name' and '$name.field' are replaced by ids from earlier results.

as.description: Name later ops use to refer to this op's result.

ops.description: Calls in order. The limit is the mcp-ext.limits.maxBatchOps preference, default 500.

atomic.description: Default true. Atomic batches refuse /undo, /redo, /new_project, /open_project, /save_project*, /execute_command, /export_pdf, /export_html, /export_diagrams, /generate_code, /reverse_code and /build_diagram.

failed.description: Ops that failed; always 0 for an atomic batch.

results.description: One entry per op, in order: the op's data, or its error code and message.

endpoints.description: Build a whole diagram in one call from a compact spec per kind (class, sequence, usecase, activity, statemachine, erd, flowchart, mindmap) or from Mermaid (classDiagram, sequenceDiagram, flowchart, erDiagram, stateDiagram; a flowchart also as activity or usecase). One undo step; laid out by Format > Layout where the kind allows. upsert updates the diagram of the same name instead of adding another. Answers the ids of what it made, not the model.

kind.description: Diagram kind; required with spec. With mermaid it is read from the header, and 'activity' or 'usecase' reads a flowchart as that kind.

spec.description:
class: {packages, classes: [{name, kind: class|interface|enum|abstract, package, stereotype, attributes: ['+id: long'], operations: ['+total(): double'], literals}], relations: [{from, to, type: association|directed|aggregation|composition|generalization|realization|dependency, name, fromMultiplicity, toMultiplicity}]}. sequence: {participants, messages: [{from, to, text, kind: sync|async|reply|create|delete}], fragments: [{operator: alt|opt|loop|..., guard, from, to}] (message indices)}. usecase: {system, actors, useCases, relations: [{from, to, type: association|include|extend|generalization}]}. activity: {lanes, nodes: [{id, name, type: action|initial|final|flowFinal|decision|merge|fork|join|object, lane}], flows: [{from, to, guard}]}. statemachine: {states: [{id, name, type: state|initial|final|choice|fork|join}], transitions: [{from, to, trigger, guard, effect}]}. erd: {entities: [{name, columns: ['id int PK', ...]}], relationships: [{from, to, fromCardinality, toCardinality: '0..1'|'1'|'0..*'|'1..*', name, identifying}]}. flowchart: {nodes: [{id, name, shape: process|decision|terminator|data|document|predefined|alternate|database|manualInput|preparation|connector|delay|display}], flows: [{from, to, label}]}. mindmap: {root: {name, children: [...]}}. Names may contain '\n' or '
' for line breaks; edges name nodes by name, or by id where nodes have one.

mermaid.description: Mermaid source instead of spec. The diagram is named by 'name', else front matter 'title:' or a 'title' line.

parentId.description: Owner of the diagram; default the project, where StarUML adds the container the kind needs (a model, interaction, activity, state machine, data model, flowchart or mind map).

direction.description: Layout direction; default TB, or Mermaid's.

autoLayout.description: Default true: Format > Layout after building. Sequence diagrams, lanes and a system boundary keep the computed placement.

upsert.description: Update the diagram with this name and kind under the parent if there is one: nodes already on it (same type and name) gain missing members and changed properties, missing nodes and edges are added, nothing is removed.

updated.description: Existing nodes given members or properties.

unchanged.description: Existing nodes and edges left as they were.

layout.description: engine: Format > Layout arranged it; placed: the computed placement stands.

ids.description: Model and view ids of each node, by its name (or id) in the spec.

endpoints.description: StarUML and extension versions, factory ids, the metamodel catalogue, the diagram editor's toolbox, and this endpoint manifest with JSON Schemas.

include.description: Sections to return besides the versions; default all.

types.description: Restrict the metamodel section to these type names.

inherited.description: List inherited attributes with each type; default false (own attributes and supers).

modelAndView.description: What each model-and-view id creates; ids such as UMLInputExpansionNode create another model type.

kind.description: prim/enum: value; ref/refs: reference(s) to other elements; obj/objs: owned element(s); var: a reference or a plain value; custom: an object StarUML stores as a string (Font, Points).

type.description: Integer, Real, String, Boolean or Image for prim; otherwise a metamodel type name.

transient.description: Runtime state; not saved or returned.

attributes.description: Own attributes; with inherited: true, inherited ones first.

viewType.description: View class that shows this model class on a diagram.

viewTypes.description: Diagrams only: view classes the diagram accepts.

creatable.description: Which factory registers this name: /create_element, /create_element_with_view and /create_relationship, /create_diagram.

diagramTypes.description: Diagrams the group is shown for; null for every diagram.

rubberband.description: line for edges; rect or point for nodes.

creates.description: The model-and-view id the item creates.

options.description: Presets the item adds, e.g. model-init attribute values or parasitic: true for elements placed on a host view (pass containerViewId).

command.description: A command other than factory:create-model-and-view; such items cannot be created through this API unless `creates` is itself a model-and-view id.

items.description: The diagram editor's palette entries; an id in several groups is listed once.

response.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) of `data` in a successful response.

schema.description: JSON Schema of an error response body.

endpoints.description: Own keys of `app` and the own and prototype members of its managers.
